Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
Whether the extra $5 is worth it depends on your specific goals and digestion:
• Our Classic Whey Protein Concentrate Powder is the best bang for your buck if you're looking for a high-quality whey protein with a rich, creamy taste and clean ingredients.
• Whey Protein Isolate Powder is our premium whey, filtered to yield the highest protein content with the fewest calories, carbs, and fats. It contains less than 1 gram of lactose per serving, making it the better choice if you are sensitive to lactose, prone to breakouts, or strict about minimal calories.
If you don't have lactose sensitivity and just want a great everyday protein to build muscle while saving money, the cheaper Classic Whey is completely fine and offers incredible value!
